cells.row-4-proof|math-program:

  (= (dist x1 y1 x2 y2) (dist x2 y2 x1 y1)))
(display (map (lambda (c) (apply holds? c))
              (list (list 0 0 3 4) (list 1 2 5 7) (list -3 -4 0 0) (list 2 2 2 2))))

cells.row-4-proof|cs-program:
(define (holds? ax ay bx by cx cy)
  (<= (dist ax ay cx cy)
      (+ (dist ax ay bx by) (dist bx by cx cy))))
(display (map (lambda (c) (apply holds? c))
              (list (list 0 0 1 1 3 4) (list 0 0 0 0 5 12) (list -1 -1 0 0 1 1))))
(newline)
cells.row-5-emergence|eng-composition:
(define (gap ax ay bx by)
  (dist ax ay bx by))
(define (nearest-to x y points)
  (fold (lambda (p best)
          (if (< (gap x y (car p) (cadr p)) (gap x y (car best) (cadr best)))
              p best))
        (car points) points))
(display (list (nearest-to 0 0 (list (list 9 9) (list 1 2) (list 5 5)))
               (nearest-to 10 10 (list (list 0 0) (list 9 9)))))
(newline)
cells.row-5-emergence|math-composition:
(define (leg ax ay bx by)
  (dist ax ay bx by))
(define (perimeter pts)
  (fold + 0 (map (lambda (a b) (leg (car a) (cadr a) (car b) (cadr b)))
                 pts (append (cdr pts) (list (car pts))))))
(display (list (perimeter (list (list 0 0) (list 3 0) (list 3 4)))
               (perimeter (list (list 0 0) (list 1 0) (list 1 1) (list 0 1)))))
(newline)
cells.row-5-emergence|cs-composition:
(define (touching? ax ay bx by r)
  (<= (dist ax ay bx by) r))
(define (collisions x y r others)
  (filter (lambda (p) (touching? x y (car p) (cadr p) r)) others))
(display (list (collisions 0 0 5 (list (list 3 4) (list 9 9) (list 1 1)))
               (collisions 0 0 1 (list (list 3 4) (list 9 9)))))
(newline)
